source.name: Torino FC, 'bet365 Scores è il nuovo Second Main Partner del Torino'
source.quote: bet365 Scores, l’app leader nell’offrire risultati e statistiche in tempo reale agli amanti del calcio, sarà il nuovo Second Main Partner del Club.
source.note: Deal value not disclosed. The same announcement places the brand's logo on the front of the shirt; the club's kit launch of 3 July 2026 confirms bet365 Scores continues as Second Main Partner in 2026/27.

note: bet365 Scores is the live-scores app brand used in Italy where direct betting sponsorship is restricted; the owner chain runs through bet365 Group (Coates family).
